name: Mortgage Calculator
implementationConventions: P=price-downpayment; annual tax/insurance/PMI divided into monthly budget, HOA frequency explicit; costs may grow annually. US nominal annual loan rate/12. Model PMI cancellation assumption separately.
limitationsAndDependencies: PMI lender rules and local taxes are user inputs; never market default rate as live.
verificationStatus: Implementation research; exact output parity and edge-case behavior still require independent tests

name: Loan Calculator
implementationConventions: Convert compounding to payment frequency; deferred amount=P*(1+j/m)^(m*t); bond present value=face/(1+j/m)^(m*t).
limitationsAndDependencies: Dates/day-count outside fixed intervals require explicit convention.
verificationStatus: Implementation research; exact output parity and edge-case behavior still require independent tests

name: Auto Loan Calculator
implementationConventions: Net principal=price-rebate-down-tradeValue+tradeDebt+financedTaxFees. Tax base varies with rebate/trade-in treatment and state.
limitationsAndDependencies: Do not infer local/state rates from a national average; version each jurisdiction if auto-tax is implemented.
verificationStatus: Implementation research; exact output parity and edge-case behavior still require independent tests

name: Interest Calculator
implementationConventions: Event-based cash-flow accumulation; taxes apply to interest earnings under declared annual timing; inflation-adjust final value.
limitationsAndDependencies: Continuous compounding and contribution timing need independent tests.
verificationStatus: Implementation research; exact output parity and edge-case behavior still require independent tests

name: Payment Calculator
implementationConventions: N formula requires payment>periodInterest; display years/months and final smaller installment.
limitationsAndDependencies: Variable-rate future cannot be known; fixed-rate estimate only.
verificationStatus: Implementation research; exact output parity and edge-case behavior still require independent tests

name: Retirement Calculator
implementationConventions: Project income growth until retirement; replacement-rate or dollar spending; net other income; inflation-adjust withdrawals; solve retirement fund PV and pre-retirement savings.
limitationsAndDependencies: Assumed returns are scenarios, no guaranteed sustainable withdrawal; lifespan user assumption.
verificationStatus: Implementation research; exact output parity and edge-case behavior still require independent tests

name: Amortization Calculator
implementationConventions: Use actual planned extra payment dates and final-payment truncation; reconcile sums of principal to original balance.
limitationsAndDependencies: No fees/taxes implied unless separately entered.
verificationStatus: Implementation research; exact output parity and edge-case behavior still require independent tests

name: Investment Calculator
implementationConventions: Support beginning/end contributions and monthly/annual schedules, independent compounding frequency.

name: Currency Calculator
implementationConventions: target=amount*quotedTargetPerSource; cross rate=targetPerEUR/sourcePerEUR if ECB base used; show quote timestamp and source.

name: Inflation Calculator
implementationConventions: historical=amount*CPI_target/CPI_start; forward=A*(1+r)^t; backward=A/(1+r)^t. Choose month or annual average consistently.
limitationsAndDependencies: BLS dataset vintage must be committed/updated; incomplete current year is not a full-year average.
verificationStatus: Implementation research; exact output parity and edge-case behavior still require independent tests

name: Finance Calculator
requiredModes: FV with P/Y,C/Y and payment timing
implementationConventions: Use signed cash-flow TVM identity and effective period-rate conversion. Exactly one unknown.

name: Mortgage Payoff Calculator

limitationsAndDependencies: Biweekly servicing/application practices affect actual savings; show model.
verificationStatus: Implementation research; exact output parity and edge-case behavior still require independent tests

name: Income Tax Calculator
implementationConventions: Use full tax pipeline, capital-gain stacking and income-specific tax bases. Separate tax liability from prepaid amounts.
limitationsAndDependencies: Full parity needs many rules beyond tax brackets, including OBBBA, QBI, AMT, NIIT, credits and phaseouts. No unverifiedstate computation.

name: Compound Interest Calculator
requiredModes: convert equivalent nominal rates across compounding frequencies

name: Salary Calculator

name: 401K Calculator

name: Interest Rate Calculator
requiredModes: solve loan annual rate from amount/payment/term

verificationStatus: Implementation research; exact output parity and edge-case behavior still require independent tests

name: Sales Tax Calculator

verificationStatus: Implementation research; exact output parity and edge-case behavior still require independent tests

name: House Affordability Calculator

name: Savings Calculator

name: Rent Calculator

name: Marriage Tax Calculator

name: Pension Calculator
